entries.title: Zonal Coordinator — Southwest Zone D
entries.description: Emerged as Zonal Coordinator in 2026, representing students across Southwest Nigeria and coordinating advocacy for student welfare.

entries.title: Advocacy for reliable campus electricity
entries.description: Led a public demonstration calling attention to unreliable electricity across campuses and student communities, and its effect on academic life.

entries.title: Assistant General Secretary
entries.description: Served as Assistant General Secretary in 2025, advocating for student welfare and transparent communication between students and the executive council.
